speaker: god
text: Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before Me.
name: The LORD

speaker: captain
text: How can you sleep? Get up and call upon your God. Perhaps this God will consider us, so that we may not perish.
name: The ship's captain

speaker: sailors
text: Come!
name: The sailors

speaker: sailors
text: Let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity that is upon us.
name: The sailors

speaker: sailors
text: Tell us now,
name: The sailors

speaker: sailors
text: who is to blame for this calamity that is upon us? What is your occupation, and where have you come from? What is your country, and who are your people?
name: The sailors

speaker: jonah
text: I am a Hebrew,
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: I worship the LORD, the God of the heavens, who made the sea and the dry land.
name: Jonah

speaker: sailors
text: What have you done?
name: The sailors

speaker: sailors
text: What must we do to you to calm this sea for us?
name: The sailors

speaker: jonah
text: Pick me up,
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: and cast me into the sea, so it may quiet down for you. For I know that I am to blame for this violent storm that has come upon you.
name: Jonah

speaker: sailors
text: Please, O LORD, do not let us perish on account of this man’s life! Do not charge us with innocent blood! For You, O LORD, have done as You pleased.
name: The sailors

speaker: jonah
text: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered me. From the belly of Sheol I called for help, and You heard my voice.
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: For You cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the current swirled about me; all Your breakers and waves swept over me.
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: At this, I said, ‘I have been banished from Your sight; yet I will look once more toward Your holy temple.’
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: The waters engulfed me to take my life; the watery depths closed around me; the seaweed wrapped around my head.
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: To the roots of the mountains I descended; the earth beneath me barred me in forever! But You raised my life from the pit, O LORD my God!
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: Those who cling to worthless idols forsake His loving devotion.
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: But I, with the voice of thanksgiving, will sacrifice to You. I will fulfill what I have vowed. Salvation is from the LORD!
name: Jonah

speaker: god
text: Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message that I give you.
name: The LORD

speaker: jonah
text: Forty more days and Nineveh will be overturned!
name: Jonah

speaker: king-of-nineveh
text: By the decree of the king and his nobles: Let no man or beast, herd or flock, taste anything at all. They must not eat or drink.
name: The king of Nineveh

speaker: king-of-nineveh
text: Furthermore, let both man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and have everyone call out earnestly to God. Let each one turn from his evil ways and from the violence in his hands.
name: The king of Nineveh

speaker: king-of-nineveh
text: Who knows? God may turn and relent; He may turn from His fierce anger, so that we will not perish.
name: The king of Nineveh

speaker: jonah
text: O LORD, is this not what I said while I was still in my own country? This is why I was so quick to flee toward Tarshish. I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion—One who relents from sending disaster.
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: And now, O LORD, please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live.
name: Jonah

speaker: god
text: Have you any right to be angry?
name: The LORD

speaker: jonah
text: It is better for me to die than to live.
name: Jonah

speaker: god
text: Have you any right to be angry about the plant?
name: The LORD

speaker: jonah
text: I do,
name: Jonah

speaker: jonah
text: I am angry enough to die!
name: Jonah

speaker: god
text: You cared about the plant, which you neither tended nor made grow. It sprang up in a night and perished in a night.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So should I not care about the great city of Nineveh, which has more than 120,000 people who cannot tell their right hand from their left, and many cattle as well?
name: The LORD
